DB-E2.Description:
Create backend/mcp/postgres.py with PostgreSQL MCP client for Task Agent access.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Create backend/mcp/__init__.py
- Create backend/mcp/client.py: base MCPClient class with call_tool() method
- Create backend/mcp/postgres.py: PostgresMCPClient extending MCPClient
- Implement tools: list_tables, query, insert
- Add connection config via settings (POSTGRES_MCP_HOST, POSTGRES_MCP_PORT)
- Implement query validation to prevent SQL injection
- Enforce RLS by requiring user_id parameter on all queries

EFFORT: M (5 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: DB-006

TESTING CRITERIA:
- MCP client connects to server
- list_tables returns available tables
- query executes and returns results
- Invalid SQL rejected before execution

EDGE CASES:
- Connection timeout: raise MCPTimeoutError after 30s
- Query timeout: raise MCPTimeoutError after 30s
- RLS bypass attempt: reject queries without user_id

Create backend/mcp/calendar.py with Google Calendar MCP client for Calendar Agent access.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Create backend/mcp/calendar.py: CalendarMCPClient extending MCPClient
- Implement tools: list_calendars, get_events
- Add connection config via settings (CALENDAR_MCP_HOST, CALENDAR_MCP_PORT)
- Implement SSRF defense: allowlist only *.googleapis.com domains
- Handle consent_required response by raising MCPConsentRequired exception
- Parse event data into structured CalendarEvent model

EFFORT: M (5 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: DB-011

TESTING CRITERIA:
- MCP client connects to server
- get_events returns today's events
- Consent required handled gracefully
- SSRF attempt blocked and logged

EDGE CASES:
- Token expired: raise MCPConsentRequired
- Rate limited: retry with backoff
- Invalid calendar_id: return empty list, not error

Create backend/agents/focus/ with Focus Agent LangGraph node.

DEPENDENCIES: DB-013, DB-014, DB-009

Create backend/llm/router.py with LLMRouter class for model selection and fallback.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Create backend/llm/__init__.py
- Create backend/llm/router.py: LLMRouter class
- Primary provider: OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_BASE_URL)
- Fallback provider: Local LLM (LOCAL_LLM_ENABLED, LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL)
- Implement generate() method with automatic fallback on rate limit/timeout
- Track tokens used and enforce budget limits
- Support force_local flag for PII data classification
- Return LLMResponse with content, model_used, tokens, latency

EFFORT: M (5 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: DB-006

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Primary provider called first
- Fallback triggered on rate limit (429)
- Fallback triggered on timeout
- Token usage tracked correctly

EDGE CASES:
- Both providers fail: raise LLMError
- PII classification: force local LLM
- Local LLM disabled: skip fallback, raise error

- Add dlq_handler node for escalated results
- Compile graph with checkpointing support

EFFORT: M (5 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: DB-017

- Full graph executes end-to-end
